headings: Our Opportunity: The Global Learning Ecosystem is Large and Growing
Our Offerings to Individuals, Organizations, and Institutions
Coursera Plus is our subscription offering that gives learners access to over 13,500 courses, Guided Projects, Specializations, and Professional Certificates on Coursera for a monthly or annual fee.
Our Competitive Strengths: The Power of Our Business Model
paragraphs: Our mission is to provide universal access to world-class learning so that anyone, anywhere can transform their life through learning. We believe learning is a powerful source of human progress, transforming our world from illness to health, from poverty to prosperity, and from conflict to peace.

As a global platform, Coursera unites educators, learners, and institutions, serving approximately 197 million learners from over 230 countries and territories as of December 31, 2025. Our content is created by a world-class ecosystem of expert instructors, including more than 200 universities and 175 industry leaders, who have developed a broad catalog of content and credentials, ranging from entry-level industry microcredentials to university degrees. These offerings are distributed globally through our platform, making high-quality, affordable education more accessible around the world.

Coursera serves learners with educational content and product experiences designed to support skills development and verification for career advancement, including interactive learning tools and personalized learning paths. Our offerings are delivered directly through our global website, on the job through employers, and through programs sponsored by colleges, universities, and government organizations. The graphic below illustrates our global learning ecosystem as of December 31, 2025:

Technology is advancing faster than the world's ability to adapt and acquire new skills. We believe that advancements in artificial intelligence ("AI") and other emerging technologies are reshaping how we live, learn, and work, and we expect these changes will further increase the global skills gap. The rapid adoption of new technologies, tools, and processes creates an urgent need for organizations and learners to adapt in order to remain competitive. To seize the opportunities created by the digital economy, many aspiring and existing professionals need to develop, master, and validate their skills in business, technology, AI, and data science. We believe education will continue to evolve with blended classrooms powered by online learning, a focus on job-relevant skills, and lifelong learning to help people adapt and learn skills that can be used to gain employment, obtain new job opportunities, improve performance in their current jobs, or run their businesses.

We envision a future of higher education that emphasizes relevance, accessibility, and affordability, meeting the demands of a rapidly changing economy. We believe that online learning will become the primary means of meeting the global demand for emerging skills and that the adoption of online education, combined with the increased flexibility enabled by remote and hybrid workforces, holds the promise to increase global access. Cross-sector collaboration is required between employers, government organizations, and universities in order to bridge the skills gap.

World-class teaching is the foundation of the Coursera experience. Coursera provides learners with high-quality, modular content and credentials at varying skill levels, price points, and durations. Product innovation such as our AI-enabled Course Builder solution is designed to streamline content production in various formats and enable customers to personalize courses tailored to their organization's objectives. Additionally, our AI translations and dubbing initiative has led to delivering our high-quality content in up to 26 languages. By leveraging Coursera's global reach and scale supported by our platform, our content creators can effectively tap into the worldwide demand for education, reaching individual learners, organizations, and institutions around the globe.

Reaching and serving a world of learners lies at the heart of our model. We strive to make it easy for learners to discover and engage with high-quality, job-relevant learning in flexible, hands-on online learning environments at affordable prices. Content and credentials from well-recognized university and industry brands have helped us attract approximately 197 million learners cost effectively and build a global consumer audience. We use data-driven marketing to efficiently attract learners to a wide range of paid offerings, including standalone courses, multi-course specializations, industry certificate programs, and university degrees. We believe this efficient learner acquisition model has allowed us to build one of the largest global audiences of adult learners and serve these learners at various price points, with competitive margins for us and our content creators.

We expect the long, episodic nature of higher education will break down into shorter, more relevant units of consumption designed to increase affordability and provide more immediate access to workforce participation. Our model lets learners leverage flexible and affordable career and learning pathways across our catalog, including "stacking" content and credentials to count as progress towards a broader program of study. Qualifying our high-quality learning catalog for credit recognition through organizations like the American Council on Education ("ACE"), the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System ("ECTS"), and India's National Skills Qualification Framework ("NSQF") enables this. For example, eligible learners who complete the Google Data Analytics Certificate can earn a credit recommendation of up to 12 college credits, the equivalent of four college courses at the bachelor's degree level in participating programs.

Coursera's data and machine-learning systems drive personalized learning and skills benchmarking. We believe that our unified technology platform is not only making higher education more globally accessible and more effective, but is also enabling educators to author and distribute high-quality content efficiently through the use of our authoring tools and our Course Builder solution, employers to upskill and reskill their talent, and learners to start and advance their careers supported by a flexible learning environment. Further, our platform allows employers to tap into a global talent pool and provides them with insight into which learners have the requisite skills for specific job roles. It also allows learners to develop and showcase their skills with industry microcredentials and hands-on projects. For example, we now offer 100 entry-level Professional Certificates, recently adding new titles from Airbus, DeepLearning.AI, ICM, and SAS. This expanded our ability to serve learners interested in a career as a cloud support associate, game designer, graphic designer, product manager, as well as many other job roles.

In addition to offering content and credentials directly to individuals at Coursera.org, we also sell directly to organizations and institutions, including employers, colleges and universities, and government entities and agencies. Employers can use Coursera for Business to help employees develop new skills in order to better acquire and serve customers, lower costs, reduce risk, and remain competitive in the new digital economy. Colleges and universities can use Coursera for Campus to deliver and integrate university and industry-branded online projects, courses, and credentials as they navigate a new era of financial challenges, pressure to deliver job-relevant skills and employable graduates, and evolving student preferences for hybrid and remote learning. Government entities and agencies can use Coursera for Government to train, reskill, and upskill employees and citizens into fast-growing digital roles that constitute a significant share of new job opportunities.

The global learning ecosystem is large and growing. As we seek to reinforce our platform's advantages and continue penetrating this market opportunity, we have multiple strategies to drive our growth. These include making continuous improvements to our learner experience to broaden access to in-demand skills and world-class education that advances careers, rapidly expanding our catalog of high-quality, job-relevant courses with more leading content creators, and guiding individual learners more effectively through improved discovery, onboarding, and a clear value proposition.

As previously announced, on December 17, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (as it may be amended from time to time, the "Merger Agreement") with Udemy, Inc. ("Udemy") and Chess Merger Sub, Inc., a direct wholly owned subsidiary of ours ("Merger Sub").

Upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Merger Agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into Udemy (the "Merger"), with Udemy surviving the Merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of ours (or if a restructuring election is made in certain circumstances in accordance with and subject to the limitations in the Merger Agreement, a direct wholly owned corporate subsidiary of ours may merge with and into Udemy, with Udemy surviving such merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of ours, followed by a merger of Udemy with and into a second, direct wholly owned limited liability company subsidiary of ours, with the second wholly owned subsidiary of ours surviving such merger). At the effective time of the Merger (the "Effective Time"), each share of common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, of Udemy (the "Udemy Common Stock") issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, except for certain shares owned by us, Udemy or Merger Sub, will be converted into the right to receive 0.800 shares of our common stock. No fractional shares of our common stock will be issued in the Merger, and holders of Udemy Common Stock will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares of our common stock, if any.

The Merger, which is anticipated to close by the second half of calendar year 2026, is subject to approval by Coursera and Udemy stockholders, the receipt of required regulatory approvals, and other customary closing conditions. In the event of a termination of the Merger Agreement under certain specified circumstances, we will be required to pay Udemy a termination fee in the amount of $40.5 million.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

Our historical growth may not be indicative of our future growth, and our revenue may not grow or could decline compared to prior years due to a variety of factors, including macroeconomic conditions.
Our offerings continue to evolve, and given our limited operating history, predicting our future financial and operating results may be affected by a number of uncertainties.
If we change the contract terms with our content creators, including pricing or contract length, it could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
If we fail to establish, maintain, and expand our content creator relationships, our ability to grow our business and revenue will suffer.
Our ability to grow and improve our financial performance depends heavily on our ability to attract and retain learners, including converting our freemium learners to paid learners.
If we fail to adapt and respond effectively to rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards, and changing customer needs or requirements, our platform may become less competitive.
If we fail to manage the growth of our business both in terms of scale and complexity, our financial results, including profit margins and financial condition, could be adversely affected.
We may change the subscription or contract terms, including our pricing models, for our offerings, which in turn could impact our operating results.
Our current operations are international in scope, and we plan to expand our international operations, which exposes us to related inherent risks.

We intend to launch new offerings and services to learners and customers to grow our business. If our efforts are not successful, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be adversely affected.
We have incurred significant net losses since inception, and we may not achieve or maintain profitability in the future.
We may not generate sufficient revenue from a new offering to offset our costs.
If we pursue unsuccessful content creator opportunities, we may forego more profitable opportunities, and our operating results and growth could be harmed.
Failure to effectively expand our sales and marketing capabilities could harm our ability to increase our customer base and achieve broader market acceptance of our platform.
If we fail to quickly and efficiently scale our operations and platform capabilities to support the needs of new and existing content creators, our reputation and our revenue will suffer.
Disruptions to the operations of one or more of our third-party service providers may adversely affect our business operations and financial condition.
paragraphs: Our business is subject to numerous risks, as more fully described in the section entitled "Risk Factors" below and elsewhere in this Form 10-K. In particular, risks associated with our business include, among others, the following, any of which could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, or prospects:
•our historical growth may not be indicative of our future growth and our growth may be adversely impacted by macroeconomic conditions;
•fluctuations in our quarterly and annual revenue and operating results could cause our stock price to fluctuate and the value of your investment to decline;
•the evolution of our offerings coupled with our limited operating history makes it difficult to predict our future financial and operating results;
•the nascency and market adoption of online learning solutions and generative AI, which may not grow or evolve as we expect, or lead to increased demand for our offerings;
•the expected timing and realization of the expected benefits of our Merger with Udemy;

paragraphs: The following section discusses the financial condition and results of operations of Coursera, Inc. and its subsidiaries ("Coursera," the "Company," "we," "us," or "our") and should be read in conjunction with our Consolidated Financial Statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K"). This discussion, particularly information with respect to our future results of operations or financial condition, business strategy and plans, and objectives of management for future operations, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties as described under the heading "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" in this Form 10-K. You should review the disclosure under the heading "Risk Factors" under Part I, Item 1A in this Form 10-K for a discussion of important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements.

Management's discussion and analysis provides a narrative on our financial performance and condition that should be read in conjunction with the accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements. It includes the following sections:
•Overview •Key Financial Results •Recent Developments •Factors Affecting Our Performance •Impact of Macroeconomic Conditions
•Components of Results of Operations •Results of Operations •Liquidity and Capital Resources
•Key Business Metrics and Non-GAAP Financial Measures •Critical Accounting Estimates •Recent Accounting Pronouncements

In this section of the Form 10-K, we discuss our financial condition and results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. Our financial condition and results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023 can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 filed with the United States ("U.S.") Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on February 24, 2025.

Coursera operates a global online learning platform that connects an ecosystem of learners, content creators, organizations, and institutions. The platform offers high-quality educational content, credentials, and learning tools to support skills development and career advancement.

We partner with over 375 content creators, including universities and industry organizations, to create and distribute educational content that is modular, flexible, and affordable. As of December 31, 2025, the platform had approximately 197 million cumulative Registered Learners.

Coursera offers a range of learning products to meet diverse educational and professional development needs, including Guided Projects, industry micro-credentials, and accredited degree programs. We continue to invest in platform capabilities to enhance and scale the delivery of online education. Recent innovations include generative AI-powered features such as Coach, Role Play, and Course Builder, as well as role-based solutions like Skills Tracks. These tools enable content creators and institutions to deliver targeted learning aligned with evolving workforce needs. Organizations across the public and private sectors use Coursera to upskill and reskill employees, students, and citizens in fields such as generative AI, data science, technology, and business.

Coursera serves individual learners and institutional customers through two operating segments: Consumer and Enterprise. The Consumer segment focuses on attracting learners via branded content, institutional partnerships, and digital marketing, supported by personalized discovery and localized recommendations. The Enterprise segment engages employers, academic institutions, and government organizations through a direct sales team, as well as data-driven insights derived from activity on the Consumer platform. This approach enables Coursera to efficiently expand its reach, while delivering learning solutions and essential skills aligned with the evolving needs of both individuals and institutions.

On December 17, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") to combine with Udemy, Inc., an online learning platform. Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, each issued and outstanding share of Udemy common stock would be converted into the right to receive 0.800 shares of our common stock. The Merger, which is anticipated to close by the second half of calendar year 2026, is subject to approval by Coursera and Udemy stockholders, the receipt of required regulatory approvals including the expiration or termination of the applicable waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended (the "HSR Act"), and other customary closing conditions. On February 9, 2026, the Federal Trade Commission granted early termination of the waiting period under the HSR Act. In the event of a termination of the Merger Agreement under certain specified circumstances, we will be required to pay Udemy a termination fee in the amount of $40.5 million.
•Total revenue was $757.5 million, up 9% from $694.7 million a year ago.
•Gross profit was $413.4 million, compared to $371.4 million a year ago. Non-GAAP gross profit was $421.6 million, compared to $379.6 million a year ago.
•Net loss was $(51.0) million, compared to $(79.5) million a year ago. Non-GAAP net income was $66.8 million, compared to $55.6 million a year ago.

headings: 待決 Udemy 商業結合
我們的機會：全球學習生態系規模龐大且持續成長
我們對個人、機構與組織的產品與服務
Coursera Plus 是我們的訂閱服務，提供學習者以每月或每年費用的方式，取得逾 13,500 門課程、導引專案、專業證書與專業證書等 Coursera 上的學習資源。
我們的競爭優勢：我們商業模式的強大
paragraphs: 本公司之使命為提供全世界級的學習資源，使任何人、任何地點都能透過學習改變人生。我們相信學習是推動人類進步的重要來源，能從疾病轉變為健康，從貧窮轉變為繁榮，並從衝突轉變為和平。
作為一個全球平台，Coursera 聯合教育者、學習者與機構，服務約 197 百萬學習者，來自超過 230 個國家及地區，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日。我們的內容由世界級的專家講師生態系統所創造，包括超過 200 所大學與 175 位產業領袖，他們已經開發出廣泛的內容與學分證書，範圍從入門級產業微證書到大學學位。這些服務透過我們的平台全球分發，使高品質、價格合理的教育更易於全球取得。
Coursera 提供學習者教育內容與產品體驗，以支持技能發展與驗證，協助職涯進展，包括互動式學習工具與個人化學習路徑。我們的課程透過我們的全球網站、在職場透過僱主，以及透過學院、大學與政府機構贊助的計畫提供。下圖說明了我們的全球學習生態系統，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日：

科技進步的速度快於世界適應與學習新技能的能力。我們相信人工智慧（"AI"）及其他新興科技的進步正在重塑我們的生活、學習與工作方式，我們預期這些變化將進一步增加全球技能缺口。新科技、工具與流程的快速採用，創造了組織與學習者必須適應以保持競爭力的迫切需求。為抓住數位經濟所創造的機會，許多有志與現有專業人士需要發展、掌握並驗證其在商業、科技、AI 與資料科學方面的技能。我們相信教育將持續演進，透過線上學習驅動的混合式課堂、聚焦於職業相關技能，以及終身學習，協助人們適應並學習可運用於就業、獲得新工作機會、改善現有工作表現或經營業務的技能。
我們預見一個強調相關性、可近性和可負擔性的高等教育未來，以符合快速變化的經濟需求。我們相信線上學習將成為滿足全球對新興技能需求的主要方式，而線上教育的採用，結合遠距與混合工作模式所提供的更高靈活性，將有潛力增加全球教育的可近性。僱主、政府機構與大學之間的跨部門合作是縮小技能缺口所必需的。

世界級的教學是 Coursera 經驗的基礎。Coursera 提供學習者不同技能層級、價格與持續時間的高品質、模組化內容與學分認證。產品創新，例如我們的 AI 互動課程建構解決方案，旨在簡化不同格式的內容製作，並讓客戶能根據其組織的目標，客製化課程。此外，我們的 AI 翻譯與配音計畫已使我們的高品質內容以最多 26 種語言提供。透過利用 Coursera 的全球規模與影響力，由我們的平台支持，內容創作者可有效地接觸全球對教育的需求，服務個人學習者、機構與組織。

達成並服務全球學習者是我們模式的核心。我們致力於讓學習者能夠輕鬆發現並參與高品質、與工作相關的學習內容，於彈性且實作導向的線上學習環境中，以具競爭力的價格進行學習。來自知名大學與產業品牌的內容與學分證書，已幫助我們以具成本效益的方式吸引約 197 百萬名學習者，並建立全球消費者大眾。我們運用數據驅動的行銷策略，有效吸引學習者至多種付費產品，包括單一課程、多課程專項、產業證書課程以及大學學位。我們認為這種高效的學習者獲取模式，使我們得以建立全球最大規模的成人學習者羣眾，並以不同價格點服務這些學習者，同時為我們與內容創作者帶來具競爭力的邊際利益。

我們預期高等教育長期且分段的性質將分解為較短、更具相關性的消費單位，以增加可負擔性並提供更即時的就業參與機會。我們的模式讓學習者能透過我們的目錄，利用靈活且可負擔的職涯與學習路徑，包括「堆疊」內容與學分認證，以計算為更廣泛學習計畫的進展。透過讓我們的高品質學習目錄獲得像美國教育委員會（"ACE"）、歐洲學分轉移與累積系統（"ECTS"）與印度國家技能資格架構（"NSQF"）等機構的學分認可，實現此目標。例如，完成 Google 數據分析證書的合格學習者可獲得最多 12 個大學學分的學分推薦，相當於參與計畫中學士學位層級的四門大學課程。

Coursera 的資料與機器學習系統驅動個人化學習與技能評估。我們相信，我們統一的科技平台不僅讓高等教育更全球化且更有效，也讓教育者能透過我們的著作工具與課程建構解決方案，高效地製作與分發高品質的內容，讓企業能提升與重新培訓人才，並讓學習者能在靈活的學習環境中啟動與進階其職涯。此外，我們的平台讓企業能接觸全球人才庫，並提供他們有關哪些學習者具備特定職務所需技能的洞察。同時也讓學習者能透過產業微學分與實作專案來發展與展示其技能。例如，我們目前提供 100 種入門級專業證書，最近新增了來自 Airbus、DeepLearning.AI、ICM 與 SAS 的新證書名稱。這擴展了我們服務對有意成為雲端支援工程師、遊戲設計師、圖形設計師、產品經理，以及許多其他職務的學習者的能力。

除了直接向個別學習者提供內容與證書外，我們也直接向機構與組織銷售，包括企業、大學與學院，以及政府機關與部門。企業可透過 Coursera for Business 幫助員工培養新技能，以更好地服務客戶、降低成本、降低風險，並在新數位經濟中保持競爭力。大學與學院可透過 Coursera for Campus 提供並整合大學與產業品牌線上專案、課程與證書，以應對新時代的財務挑戰、交付與就業相關技能與可就業畢業生的壓力，以及學生對混合式與遠距學習的偏好變遷。政府機關與部門可透過 Coursera for Government 培訓、重新培訓與提升員工與公民的技能，以應對快速成長的數位職務，這些職務佔據了許多新工作機會。
全球學習生態系規模龐大且持續成長。為強化我們平台的優勢並持續切入這個市場機會，我們有多項策略來推動成長。這些包括持續改善學習者體驗，以擴大對高需求技能與世界級教育的接觸，進而促進職涯發展；快速擴充我們高品質、與工作相關課程的目錄，並加入更多領先內容製造者；以及透過改善搜尋、入門流程與明確的價值主張，更有效地引導個別學習者。
如先前所公告，我們於 2025 年 12 月 17 日與 Udemy, Inc.（"Udemy"）及 Chess Merger Sub, Inc.（"Merger Sub"）簽訂了合併協議（"Merger Agreement"）。

根據 Merger Agreement 的條款與條件，Merger Sub 將與 Udemy 合併（"Merger"），Udemy 將在合併後繼續作為我們的 wholly owned 子公司（或在特定情況下，根據 Merger Agreement 的規定與限制，我們的直接 wholly owned 資本公司將與 Udemy 合併，Udemy 將在合併後繼續作為我們的 wholly owned 子公司，隨後 Udemy 將與我們的第二個直接 wholly owned 有限責任公司子公司合併，第二個 wholly owned 子公司將在合併後繼續作為我們的子公司）。在合併生效時間（"Effective Time"），每 shares of common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, of Udemy（"Udemy Common Stock"）在生效時間前發行且流通的 shares，除我們、Udemy 或 Merger Sub 所持有的 shares 外，將轉換為取得我們 common stock 0.800 shares 的權利。不會發行我們 common stock 的 fractional shares，若有任何 fractional shares，Udemy Common Stock 持有人將獲得現金代替。
預計於 2026 年財務年度第二季前完成的 Merger，需經 Coursera 與 Udemy 股東批准、取得必要的監管批准及其他慣例關閉條件。若因特定情況導致 Merger Agreement 終止，我們將需支付 Udemy 終止費用 40.5 百萬美元。

paragraphs: 下列段落討論 Coursera, Inc. 及其子公司（"Coursera," "本公司," "我們," "我們," 或 "我們的"）的財務狀況與營運成果，應與我們的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀，這些內容出現在本年度報告表 10-K（"表 10-K"）的其他部分。本討論，特別是關於我們未來營運成果或財務狀況、商業策略與計畫，以及管理階層未來營運目標的資訊，包含涉及風險與不確定性的展望性陳述，如 "特別說明展望性陳述" 項目中所述。您應審閱 "風險因素" 項目下的揭露，以瞭解可能導致我們實際結果與這些展望性陳述中預期結果有重大差異的重要因素。
管理階層討論與分析提供我們財務表現與財務狀況的敘述，應與附屬的合併財務報表一併閱讀。其包含以下項目：
•總覽 •關鍵財務結果 •近期發展 •影響我們營運的因素 •總體經濟條件的影響
•營運成果的組成部分 •營運成果 •流動性與資本資源
•關鍵業務指標與非 GAAP 財務指標 •關鍵會計估計 •近期會計準則宣佈

在本表 10-K 的此部分，我們討論本公司 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的財務狀況與營運成果。本公司 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的財務狀況與營運成果，可於本公司 2024 年財務年度年度報告表 10-K 的第二部分，第 7 項 "管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析" 中找到，該報告已於 2025 年 2 月 24 日提交至美國（"美國"）證券交易委員會（"SEC"）。
Coursera 運作一個全球在線學習平台，連接學習者、內容創作者、機構與組織的生態系統。該平台提供高品質的教育內容、證書與學習工具，以支持技能發展與職涯進步。
我們與超過 375 名內容創作者合作，包括大學與產業機構，以創造與發佈模組化、靈活且經濟實惠的教育內容。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，該平台約有 197 百萬名累計註冊學習者。

Coursera 提供多樣化的學習產品，以滿足不同教育與專業發展需求，包括 Guided Projects、產業微學分證書，以及認可的學位課程。我們持續投資於平台功能，以提升並擴展線上教育的交付能力。近期創新包括基於生成式 AI 的功能，例如 Coach、Role Play 與 Course Builder，以及基於角色的解決方案，例如 Skills Tracks。這些工具使內容創作者與機構能夠提供符合勞動市場需求的定向學習。公部門與私部門的組織使用 Coursera 來提升與再培訓員工、學生與公民，領域包括生成式 AI、數據科學、科技與商業。

Coursera 透過兩個營運分部服務個人學習者與機構客戶：Consumer 與 Enterprise。Consumer 分部專注於透過品牌內容、機構合作與數位行銷吸引學習者，並由個人化搜尋與本地化推薦支援。Enterprise 分部透過直接銷售團隊與 Consumer 平台上的活動所衍生的數據驅動洞察，與僱主、學術機構與政府組織合作。此方法使 Coursera 能夠高效擴展其影響力，同時提供符合個人與機構需求的學習解決方案與必要技能。

於 2025 年 12 月 17 日，我們與 Udemy, Inc.（線上學習平台）簽訂合併協議（"合併協議"），以合併雙方。根據合併協議的條款，每發行且流通中的 Udemy 普通股將轉換為取得我們普通股 0.800 股之權利。預期於 2026 年財曆年第二季前完成此合併，但需經 Coursera 與 Udemy 股東批准，取得必要的監管批准，包括根據 1976 年《哈特-斯科特-羅德尼反壟斷改進法案》（"HSR 法案"）所規定的等待期屆滿或終止，以及其他慣例性關閉條件。於 2026 年 2 月 9 日，美國聯邦貿易委員會已批准 HSR 法案的等待期提前終止。若在特定情況下終止合併協議，我們將需支付 Udemy 終止費用 40.5 百萬美元。
•總營業收入為 757.5 百萬美元，較去年同期的 694.7 百萬美元成長 9%。
•毛利為 413.4 百萬美元，較去年同期的 371.4 百萬美元。非 GAAP 毛利為 421.6 百萬美元，較去年同期的 379.6 百萬美元。
•淨虧損為 (51.0) 百萬美元，較去年同期的 (79.5) 百萬美元。非 GAAP 淨收入為 66.8 百萬美元，較去年同期的 55.6 百萬美元。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們的歷史成長可能無法反映未來成長，且因多種因素，包括總體經濟情況，我們的營業收入可能不會成長，甚至較前一年度下降。
我們的產品持續進化，考慮到我們有限的營運歷史，預測我們未來的財務與營運結果可能受到許多不確定因素的影響。
若我們改變與內容創作者的合約條款，包括價格或合約期間，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
若我們未能建立、維持並擴展與內容創作者的關係，將會影響我們業務與收入的成長能力。
我們成長並改善財務表現的能力，高度依賴我們吸引並留住學習者的能力，包括將我們的免費學習者轉換為付費學習者。
若我們未能有效適應並回應快速變化的技術、進化的產業標準及變動的客戶需求或要求，我們的平台可能會變得較不具競爭力。
若我們未能妥善管理本公司業務在規模與複雜度上的成長，將可能對我們的財務結果，包括利潤率與財務狀況，造成不利影響。
我們可能針對我們的產品與服務調整訂閱或合約條款，包括我們的定價模式，這將可能影響我們的營運結果。
我們目前的業務運作具有國際性，並計畫擴大國際業務，這使我們面臨相關內在風險。
我們有意發佈新的產品與服務給學習者與客戶以促進業務成長。若我們的計畫未能成功，將可能對我們的業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
自成立以來，我們已產生顯著的淨虧損，且我們可能無法在未來達成或維持獲利。
我們可能無法從新產品中產生足夠的收入以彌補我們的成本。
若我們追蹤的內容創作者機會未能成功，我們可能放棄更具利潤的機會，這將可能對我們的營運結果與成長造成損害。
若未能有效拓展我們的銷售與行銷能力，將可能影響我們擴大客戶羣與實現平台更廣泛市場接受度的能力。

paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨許多風險，詳情請參閱本Form 10-K下方及其它部分標題為『風險因素』的節。特別是與本公司業務相關的風險包括，但不限於以下各項，任何一項都可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景產生不利影響：
•本公司歷史成長情形可能無法反映未來成長，且本公司成長可能因總體經濟條件而受到不利影響；
•本公司每季及每年的營業收入與營運結果波動，可能導致本公司股票價格波動，進而使您的投資價值下降；
•本公司產品的演進與本公司有限的營運歷史，使預測本公司未來財務與營運結果變得困難；
•線上學習解決方案與生成式AI的發展與市場採用程度尚處於初期階段，這些領域可能無法如預期成長或演進，或導致對本公司產品需求增加；
•本公司與Udemy合併後預期效益的實現時間與實際效益可能與預期不同；
